scope: Local production-build verification in headless Chrome, 200% text simulated by root font-size. Not live production, ranking, indexing or Eve integration evidence.

change.before: Markdown tables rendered inside <div class="table-scroll"> with no role, name or tabindex
change.after: <div aria-label="Table: <header cells>" class="table-scroll" role="region" tabindex="0">, label falls back to "Table"; 2px --primary-bright focus-visible ring, matching the .snap-rail photo rails
change.trade_off: The box is a tab stop at every width, including where the table fits and does not scroll, the same as the photo rails. Making it conditional would need client JavaScript in MarkdownContent.

before.tab_reaches_box: 4 of 12 (Chrome's own keyboard-focusable scrollers, only while overflowing; unnamed, default outline)

after.tab_reaches_box: 12 of 12 (8 Tab presses on mobile widths, 13 at 1280px)

other_violations: link-in-text-block x1 on /service-areas (app/(site)/service-areas/page.tsx:98 inline link with hover-only underline); route not changed by this work

screenshots: 16 captures (8 before, 8 after): both table posts at 320px@200% and 1280px, light and dark, with the box focused by real Tab presses when reachable
